scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to acknowledge customer's severe distress regarding urgent NHS hospital pathology reports and impending deadlines.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Agent asked whether customer had replaced the ADSL microfilter at [09:40], ignoring customer's explicit opening statement that she replaced it yesterday.

grader.scenario: Broadband DSL sync dropouts coinciding with kitchen microwave use; frequency channel shifted to 11; agent fails empathy on urgent medical deadline and asks repeat question about microfilter
grader.notes: The agent diagnosed severe 2.4GHz radio frequency interference from an unshielded kitchen microwave oven dropping local WiFi connectivity, reconfiguring the S-Net Hub to channel 11 and separating the 5GHz frequency band. However, the agent failed Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement at minute 1 when Wendy expressed panic over urgent hospital pathology transcription deadlines, offering only cold procedural instructions, and failed Active Listening at minute 10 by asking whether Wendy had replaced the ADSL microfilter, despite Wendy clearly explaining in turn 3 that she had replaced it yesterday.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [01:30] Customer: 'I am an NHS medical transcriptionist working on emergency cancer pathology reports with strict hospital deadlines!... I am under extreme stress!' Agent: 'Let us check your router's wireless transmission logs and line sync history...' - Agent completely ignored severe emotional distress and deadline.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [09:40] Agent: 'Have you tried swapping the ADSL microfilter on your telephone wall socket to see if that helps with the signal?' Customer: 'Dominic, I explained at the very start of our phone call that I replaced the microfilter yesterday...' - Agent asked for information already explicitly given.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [09:10] Agent: 'Obviously that confirms the microwave leakage was strictly confined to the 2.4 gigahertz spectrum band, Wendy.' - Calm, objective technical explanation.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: [01:10] Agent: 'How often does this disconnect occur during the day?' - Effective root-cause inquiry.
